LanguageData.MAP_Settings.PsychicCoreMentalStateRecov: Allow level 10 psychic cores to remove mental states
When enabled, attempt every 10 seconds to remove mental states from characters whose psychic core has reached maximum level.
LanguageData.MAP_Settings.Reset.Section.Confirmation: Reset the settings in {0} to default?
LanguageData.MAP_Settings.Autonomy.Sun.Label: Enable Sun autonomy
LanguageData.MAP_Settings.Autonomy.Sun.Description: When enabled, Sun becomes an autonomous mechanoid that needs no overseer. When disabled, it uses vanilla mechanoid oversight logic. Changes take effect immediately.
LanguageData.MAP_Settings.Autonomy.Hermit.Label: Enable Hermit autonomy
LanguageData.MAP_Settings.Autonomy.Hermit.Description: When enabled, Hermit becomes an autonomous mechanoid that needs no overseer. When disabled, it uses vanilla mechanoid oversight logic. This setting does not affect Hermit's bandwidth functions. Changes take effect immediately.
LanguageData.MAP_Settings.AnnihilationCannonCrater.De: When enabled, the annihilation cannon creates a crater at its impact location. Affects both friendly and hostile Suns.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.WorkTab: Show mechanoid mechanitors in the Work tab
When enabled, eligible mechanoid mechanitors appear in the vanilla "Work" tab for adjusting work priorities. Disable this if it conflicts with mods that alter the Work tab or work priority interface.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Portrai: Enable mechanoid "Show portrait" in all saves
When enabled, the "Show portrait" toggle is available for mechanoids in all saves. When disabled, it is only available in the mechanoid mechanitor scenario.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.DataPro: Refresh dynamic allocation immediately when drafting changes
When enabled, mechanoids using dynamic allocation perform a state check immediately when their drafted state changes.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.LoadDea: This is a developer feature. If your mechanoid mechanitor unexpectedly dies while loading a save, use this feature to generate logs and send them to the author for investigation.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Prevent: Prevent mechanoid mechanitor deaths during save loading
When enabled, prevent previously living mechanoid mechanitors from dying unexpectedly due to peculiar logic conflicts while a save is loading.
LanguageData.MAP_Settings.StartupDetailedLogging.Labe: Output detailed logs at game startup
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Compati: When enabled, output detailed logs if compatibility patches fail to load
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.BrainIm: Allow mechanoid mechanitors to install brain implants
When enabled, mechanoid mechanitors can be ordered to install brain implants through right-click commands. This slightly affects loading speed at game startup.
This setting takes effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.MoonImp: When enabled, Moon can right-click implant items to install them. This slightly affects loading speed at game startup. Restart the game after changing this setting.
This setting has changed and requires a game restart to take effect.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Synthet: When enabled, offspring gestated by mechanoids with bionic gestation capability additionally inherit their partner's xenogenes.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.PurgeDi: Enable Purge directive UI loading screen
When enabled, show the progress bar screen while contacting the cerebrex.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Minimum: Mechanoid mechanitor skill passion is at least "Passion"
When enabled, all mechanoid mechanitors' skill passions are never below "Passion".
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Prevent: Prevent mechanoid mechanitor skill XP decay
When enabled, prevents skill XP decay for mechanoid mechanitors.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Symbios: Adjust the multiplier for positive and negative changes to trust and unity in the Symbiosis covenant.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Strateg: The settings below specify the independent base probability for each eligible completed node. The combined probability for multiple nodes is calculated as 1-(1-p)^n.
Maximum number of uncleared outposts that can be generated within a traversable path distance of 20 tiles from each player colony on the surface.
Daily raid probability per hostile outpost: {0}%
Independent base probability used by each eligible completed hostile faction outpost during its additional daily raid check.
Independent base probability for each eligible completed allied faction outpost to provide reinforcements after a hostile raid on the colony.
Threat point multiplier for the garrison when an outpost is generated.\nOnly affects newly generated regular faction outposts.
Mechanoid hive node limit near each colony: {0}
Maximum number of uncleared mechanoid hive nodes that can be generated within a traversable path distance of 20 tiles from each player colony on the surface.
Daily raid probability per hostile node: {0}%
Daily probability for each mechanoid hive node to launch an additional raid while the hive is hostile.
Probability for each mechanoid hive node to provide reinforcements while allied with the hive.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Justice: Mechanoid abilities
Allow ability unlock: Body recoding
When enabled, completing standard mechtech research grants Body recoding to Justice, as well as to mechanical consciousness hosts in the Mechanoid mechanitor scenario.
Allow ability unlock: Body reconstruction
When enabled, completing high mechtech research grants Body reconstruction to Justice, as well as to mechanical consciousness hosts in the Mechanoid mechanitor scenario.
Allow ability unlock: Body hacking
When enabled, completing ultra mechtech research grants Body hacking to Justice, as well as to mechanical consciousness hosts in the Mechanoid mechanitor scenario.
Enable additional work modes
When enabled, completing the corresponding research unlocks additional work modes.
Restrict body hacking boss targets
When enabled, body hacking cannot target mechanoid bosses other than the diabolus and war queen.
Justice boss battle difficulty
Adjust the parameters of the Justice - Heavy command unit boss battle. Only affects subsequent waves.
Enable detailed Justice boss diagnostic logs
Generate detailed logs for the Justice boss battle. Developer option; may cause game lag.
Summon high-shield
When enabled, Justice summons a mech high-shield when deploying facilities.
Summon low-shield
When enabled, Justice summons a mech low-shield when deploying facilities.
Auto mortars: {0}
Number of auto mortars deployed after Justice arrives.
Auto charge turrets: {0}
Number of auto charge turrets deployed after Justice arrives.
Auto inferno turrets: {0}
Number of auto inferno turrets deployed after Justice arrives.
Summoning waves: {0}
After summoning this number of mechanoid waves, Justice stops summoning and leaves after a while.
Wave interval: {0} seconds
Time Justice waits between summoning two mechanoid waves.
Mechanoids per wave: {0}
Number of mechanoids Justice summons per wave. Note: the first wave summons twice this number.
Allow boss mechanoid generation
When enabled, each regular wave has a 2% chance to generate a boss mechanoid.
Add Mobile warfare to summoned units
When enabled, Justice adds the Mobile warfare health condition to the mechanoids it summons.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Cerebre: Adjust the parameters of the cerebrex boss battle. Only affects subsequent waves.
When enabled, allow the cerebrex to use the following additional abilities.
When enabled, the cerebrex periodically summons additional mechanoid reinforcements.
Wait time between two summoning waves.
Number of mechanoids each summoning wave attempts to summon.
Maximum number of cerebrex-summoned mechanoids present at once.
Apply Mobile warfare to summoned units
When enabled, the cerebrex adds the Mobile warfare health condition to the mechanoids it summons.
When enabled, the cerebrex periodically disrupts the bandwidth of player faction mechanoids.
Minimum cooldown between the end of one bandwidth disruption and the next activation.
Maximum cooldown between the end of one bandwidth disruption and the next activation.
Maximum duration allowed for a single bandwidth disruption.
Maximum number of targets a single bandwidth disruption can select.
When enabled, the cerebrex periodically releases EMP shockwaves.
Minimum cooldown between one EMP release and the next.
Maximum cooldown between one EMP release and the next.
Base duration of the stun inflicted on targets by the EMP shockwave.
Maximum radius affected by the EMP shockwave.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Product: Work speed offset per productivity core level
Set the mechanoid work speed offset granted by each productivity core level; range 0 to 10000.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Insects: Prevent insect hive raids while allied with the insect hive
When enabled, block vanilla infestations and infestations generated by the vanilla quest system while allied with the insect hive.\nA warning is logged whenever an infestation is blocked.
Allow pursuit mode infestations to ignore overhead mountains
When enabled, pursuit mode infestations can spawn in areas without overhead mountains.
Pursuit mode starting grace period: {0} days
Set the number of game days at the start during which pursuit events cannot occur.
Daily probability of triggering insect pursuit.
Daily probability of triggering an additional infestation event.
Insect pursuit surface swarm point multiplier: {0}%
Threat point multiplier for insects that arrive on foot from the map edge during insect pursuit.
Insect pursuit underground infestation point multiplier: {0}%
Threat point multiplier for the burrowing infestation during insect pursuit.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidPrioritizedWorkOrders_Label: Allow prioritized work orders for mechanoids
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidPrioritizedWorkOrders_Descr: When enabled, regular mechanoids can receive prioritized work orders through right-click commands.
